name: Z.ai GLM Coding Plan

tiers.name: Lite

limits.toolRestrictions: Strictly limited to supported coding tools (Claude Code, Cline, OpenCode, Goose)

estimatedTokenBudget.assumptions: 48M–97M tokens/week at 95% cache hit rate * 4 weeks (~200M–600M tokens/mo depending on off-peak usage)

tiers.notes: Entry tier for individual developers. Up to 92% savings vs pay-as-you-go

tiers.name: Pro

limits.includedMcps: Vision, Web Search, Web Reader, Zread

estimatedTokenBudget.assumptions: 290M–580M tokens/week at 95% cache hit rate * 4 weeks (~1.2B–3B tokens/mo)

tiers.notes: 5x Lite usage capacity for full-time engineers and agent loops

tiers.name: Max

limits.priority: Priority resource allocation during peak hours

estimatedTokenBudget.assumptions: 676M–1.35B tokens/week at 95% cache hit rate * 4 weeks (~3B–8B tokens/mo)

tiers.notes: 20x Lite usage capacity for power developers and heavy autonomous agents

tiers.name: Team Standard

limits.dataPrivacy: Excluded from model training by default
limits.billing: Centralized billing, seat management & VAT invoicing

tiers.notes: Enterprise team workspace with Zero Data Retention and seat controls

gotchas: Strictly tool-only: direct generic API scraping or unauthorized tools trigger error 1113 or risk control suspension
Dual 5-hour rolling limits and 7-day weekly reset cycles — exhaustion requires waiting for 5-hour refresh
Peak hours (Mon-Fri 14:00-18:00 UTC+8) consume credits at 2x the off-peak rate
Subscriptions are non-refundable once purchased; downgrading team seats mid-cycle is not supported
tosHighlights: Includes Web Search MCP, Web Reader MCP, Zread MCP, and Vision Understanding with 0 separate tool fees
Drop-in endpoint https://api.z.ai/api/anthropic allows using Claude Code directly with GLM-5.3
Team Plan guarantees code and conversations are excluded from model training by default
dataTraining: Excluded from model training on Team plans; standard cloud terms for personal plans
